data.name: Aabirah
data.gender_notes: Aabirah is used as a female name in Arabic and Urdu naming tradition.
data.short_meaning: Female passer-by; she who crosses or traverses
data.long_meaning: Aabirah (عابرة) is an Arabic name meaning “Female passer-by; she who crosses or traverses”. It is a transliteration of the feminine active participle ʿābiroh (عابرة), the feminine of ʿābir 'passer-by', from the root ʿ-b-r. Aabira and Aabirah are two transliterations of the same Arabic name; the final -h is silent in pronunciation.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabirah carries the meaning Female passer-by; she who crosses. Any spiritual reading placed on the name is interpretive and is labelled as such; the lexical meaning is the documented core.
data.etymology: Feminine of Arabic ʿābir (عابر) 'passer-by', from the root ʿ-b-r.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabirah total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with change, freedom and adaptability. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aabirah mean?
faq.a: Aabirah means Female passer-by; she who crosses or traverses.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aabirah?
What language does the name Aabirah come from?
faq.a: Aabirah is used in Arabic and Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aabirah a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabirah is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aabirah written in Arabic?
faq.a: Aabirah is written عابرة in Arabic, عابرہ in Urdu and आबिरा in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aabirah?
faq.a: The root of Aabirah is ʿ-b-r (ع-ب-ر), from ʿābiroh (عابرة).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aabirah?
faq.a: Aabirah is the feminine of Arabic ʿābir (عابر), passer-by, from the root ʿ-b-r.

faq.q: Does Aabirah appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabirah is not itself a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: What is the masculine form of Aabirah?
faq.a: The masculine form is ʿĀbir (عابر), passer-by, listed in this dataset as Aabir.

faq.q: Is Aabirah the same name as Aabira?
faq.a: Yes. Aabira and Aabirah are two transliterations of the same Arabic name ʿābiroh (عابرة); the final -h is silent in pronunciation.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabirah verified?
faq.a: Yes. The meaning Female passer-by rests on the Arabic feminine active participle ʿābiroh, from ʿ-b-r.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aabirah?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabirah total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is traditionally associated with change, freedom and adaptability. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aabirah?
faq.a: Variants and alternative transliterations include Abira and Aabira.

faq.q: Where is the name Aabirah used today?
faq.a: Aabirah circulates chiefly in Arabic and Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
